title: I made a Roblox game where you build your house brick by brick, and the streets outside belong to zombies
author: ImprovementNo6161
selftext:
Hey r/roblox,



I've been making this on my own since the end of September and put it out on October 7. It's called Brick House: Zombie Town.



You get your own plot in a small neighborhood and build whatever you want out of bricks. If you hold the place button, the blueprint keeps stretching into a row, and when you let go the bricks drop in one after another. That part took me way more tuning than I'd like to admit. You can also fill a whole floor or roof at once, furnish the place (doors, windows, lights, beds and so on, in 10 styles), and your bricks come by truck while furniture gets dropped off by rocket.



Once you step off your plot though, the streets are zombie territory. You fight with a plank you swing with both hands, and if you hold the attack long enough it charges up to a x10 slam that sends them flying. Across the road there's an abandoned building that's pitch dark inside with zombies on every floor, and more of them show up at night.



A couple of things before you try it:



\- Since the game is brand new, Roblox only lets age-verified 16+ accounts in for now. It opens up to younger players once enough people have played it.

\- The menus in the clip are in Korean because that's my own setting. The game shows your language (English plus 17 others).



[https://www.roblox.com/games/130627894722969/Brick-House-Zombie-Town](https://www.roblox.com/games/130627894722969/Brick-House-Zombie-Town)



What I'd really like to know is where new players get stuck in the first few minutes, because I can see a lot of people leaving early and I haven't figured out why yet. Any feedback helps, even if it's just "this part is boring". Thanks for reading.
